instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Outdoors in front of a light gray residential house, the man in the black puffer jacket (R2) stands on the left in profile, smiling as he shakes hands with the woman in the black patterned blouse (R1), who stands on the right facing him. They are shaking right hands, and the man holds a set of keys in his left hand. The background is softly blurred under natural overcast daylight with cool, soft tones.
